distance: unit-cost Levenshtein on Unicode casefold strings; no other normalization
output_gate: reject empty output or any Unicode whitespace; exact fallback to original PARSeq
go_rule: recovered>damaged AND (exact>502 OR lexical_matches>503) AND predicted_tokens<=1203

scientific_choices.choice: TRAIN post-hoc gates on frozen conservative Qwen caption outputs; thresholds1 and2 predeclared, no model or prompt changes. Raw and casefold distances saved; casefold distance drives the two gates consistently with casefold evaluation.

GT-independent per-crop gate. Exact/recovered/damaged reuse frozen audit GT-to-best-IoU-crop assignment, NOT oracle multi-fragment associations. Image lexical matching uses casefold multisets, without geometry/order.
TRAIN diagnostic GO is not independent generalization or permission to promote. No strict routing changes. Aggregate difference503 minus502 does not count individual assignment failures.
